observation: Read characters0–3785 of6518, not the complete paper selection. Page1's abstract has two intervention branches: faucet flow controls the average temperature, and hand motion distributes heat. A cooling/heating model feeds calibration with external and team-collected experiments, then a common deviation objective selects a simulated flow (reported1.81gallons/minute, about11% maximum). Parameter variations give directional findings for insulation/additives but explicitly no clear volume/surface-area trend; retain this non-result rather than inventing a simple rule. The ending offers an alternative product for people avoiding hand motions. The batch then includes a separate title/date cover and the first two paragraphs of a second numbered Abstract; it has not delivered that second abstract's remainder yet. Form instructions including 'Type a summary' are third-party submission directions, not author language. Page2 title/date and the page3 tem-/perature split need source checking. No formula or figure interpretation performed and no fidelity acceptance.
